User: NE4 5AB
Agent: Postcode N-E-4-5-A-B — right. What’s the house number or property name?
User: 10
Agent: House number 10 — perfect. And the street name?
User: Green Rd
Agent: Green Rd — brilliant. So that’s 10 Green Rd, postcode N-E-4-5-A-B. Is that right?
User: Yes, that's right
Agent: I’m just checking the nearest service slots now.
Agent: Got it. I’ve got today at 6pm, or tomorrow afternoon from 1.30pm. Which suits?
User: Tomorrow works
Agent: Tomorrow afternoon — lovely. Linda, I’ve got 10 Green Rd, postcode N-E-4 5-A-B, tomorrow from 1.30pm. Sound okay?
User: Yes, book it
Agent: Right, I’m booking that in now.
Agent: Brilliant, you’re booked in. Is there anything else I can help you with?
User: No, that's all thanks. Bye!
